queries.semantic_scholar: ("large language model" | LLM | GPT-4 | ChatGPT | Claude | LLaMA | PaLM | Bard | "generative AI" | "transformer model" | "AI language model" | "deep learning model" ) + ("title screening" | "abstract screening" | "study selection" | "record screening" | "citation screening" | "eligibility screening" | "systematic review screening" | "screening of titles" | "screening of abstracts" | "SR screening") + (sensitivity | specificity | precision | recall | "F1 score")

rationale: The queries combined the LLM block with the screening block using AND, and added a third block of accuracy terms to keep results within a manageable size. PubMed required narrowing to title/abstract fields and adding outcome keywords, while Europe PMC needed all terms forced into TITLE_ABS and also benefited from the outcome block. Semantic Scholar’s flexible syntax allowed a single combined query with the three blocks, yielding a similar hit count. This balances sensitivity—capturing all relevant LLM‑screening studies—with precision by limiting to records that report performance metrics.
